## Professional Summary
AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI, Compound AI Systems, and Scalable MLOps. Expertise in architecting privacy-preserving RAG pipelines and deterministic multi-agent workflows that bridge the gap between advanced research and business outcomes.

## Technical Arsenal
*   **Agentic AI:** LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), n8n, A2A
*   **AI Safety & Observability:** Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, Ragas, LLM-as-a-Judge, Guardrails
*   **Machine Learning:** PyTorch, Transformers, Transfer Learning, SHAP, CNNs, LSTMs
*   **RAG Systems:** Hybrid Retrieval, Cross-Encoder Reranking, Vector DBs (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector)
*   **DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, CI/CD, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
